tasks.title: Announcement #56
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university event.
tasks.transcript: Attention, everyone. We are thrilled to announce that the university's annual spring concert will take place next Friday at 7 PM in the auditorium. There will be performances by various student bands and musical groups. We hope to see you there.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：We are thrilled to announce that the university's annual spring concert will take place next Friday at 7 PM in the auditorium. 选项分析： A. A band audition 乐队试演。公告中未提及试演，所以A选项错误。 B. A new music class 一门新的音乐课。公告中未提及课程，所以B选项错误。 C. A student meeting 一次学生会议。公告中未提及会议，所以C选项错误。 D. An upcoming Spring Concert 一场即将到来的春季音乐会。公告明确宣布年度春季音乐会的时间地点，所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What does the speaker hope the listeners will do?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：说话者希望听众做什么？ 定位原文：We hope to see you there. 选项分析： A. Join a music class 加入音乐课。公告中未提及音乐课，所以A选项错误。 B. Audition for the band 参加乐队试演。公告中未提及试演，所以B选项错误。 C. Volunteer at the event 在活动中做志愿者。公告中未提及志愿者招募，所以C选项错误。 D. Attend the concert 参加音乐会。说话者说“希望在那里见到你”，即希望听众到场参加音乐会，所以D选项正确。
